version.changelog: Initial release. Adds a one-question-at-a-time intake for project, occupancy, building, space, exit, and accessibility data; scope confirmation; per-space Occupant Load Table per IBC §1004 / Table 1004.5; Exit Capacity Matrix per §1005 and §1006; Travel Distance & Path Matrix per §1006.2.1, §1017, §1020; Accessible Means of Egress Matrix per §1009; relevant Special-Condition checks (Assembly, Group H, Group I-2 / I-3, atrium, mall, storm shelter, high-piled storage); a ranked deficiency list with design fixes; and an Unresolved Information list. Output is always labeled **DRAFT — REGISTERED DESIGN PROFESSIONAL AND AHJ REVIEW REQUIRED**.

llm.summary: This skill is a Markdown-only drafting aid for building egress review and does not request unusual system access or hidden authority.

dimensions.detail: The purpose is coherent and disclosed: it reviews user-provided design data against IBC 2024 Chapter 10 and repeatedly frames output as a draft requiring registered professional and AHJ review. The domain is safety-sensitive, so users should treat outputs as advisory.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to staged intake, calculations, cited matrices, deficiency lists, and unresolved-information tracking. They prohibit final certification, stamped deliverables, and AHJ-reserved decisions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md. No executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or runtime components were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requested inputs are proportionate to egress analysis: project context, occupancy, floor areas, exits, travel distances, and accessibility details. The skill tells users not to provide addresses, owner names, tenant names, or permit-linked identifiers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, credential or session access, local indexing, file mutation, network automation, or privilege escalation is requested or implemented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install as a drafting and coordination aid. Do not treat its output as final code compliance, and verify local AHJ amendments, adopted code edition, and all citations with a registered design professional or code official before permit submission or construction.
